name: agent-bridge
description: Let Claude and Copilot hand coding work to OpenAI Codex, and ask it for second opinions. Install and it works until you disable it.

commands.title: Agent Bridge: Enable for Codex and Claude Code
Agent Bridge: Remove from Codex and Claude Code
Agent Bridge: Toggle conserve mode (push more work to Codex)

agentBridge.defaultProject.description: Folder Codex runs in when a request does not name one. Leave blank to use the open workspace.

agentBridge.conserveMode.description: Treat delegating to Codex as the default rather than the exception. Turn this on when you are short on Claude usage.

agentBridge.codexPath.description: Full path to the codex command. Leave blank to detect it automatically: PATH first, then the usual install locations and the ChatGPT and Codex apps. Set this only to override what detection finds.

agentBridge.claudePath.description: Full path to the claude command. Leave blank to detect it automatically: PATH first, then the usual install locations and the Claude app. Set this only to override what detection finds.
